core_obligations: List the irreducible components W_j of the support of F of delta-dimension k+1, note the family is locally finite, and define for each generic point xi_j the determinant f_j of the localised two-periodic complex, a unit in the function field of W_j (proof lines 18448-18461).

Reduce the claimed rational equivalence to a coefficient comparison: for an integral closed subscheme Z of dimension k with generic point xi, set A = O_{X,xi} and M = F_xi, observe dim(Supp M) = 1 and identify the components W_j through xi with the minimal primes q_i of Supp(M) (proof lines 18471-18493).

Compute both coefficients: the coefficient of [Z] in [H^0]_k - [H^1]_k is -e_A(M, phi, psi) and the coefficient in sum (W_j -> X)_* div(f_j) is the sum over the q_i of ord_{A/q_i}(det_{kappa(q_i)}(M_{q_i}, phi, psi)), and conclude by the length-determinant proposition (proof lines 18494-18505).
proof_roadmap: Set up the divisors f_j attached to the top dimensional components (proof lines 18448-18468).
Reduce to coefficients at the generic point of an arbitrary k-dimensional integral closed subscheme (proof lines 18471-18493).
Evaluate both coefficients and invoke the length-determinant proposition (proof lines 18494-18505).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a coherent sheaf F on X with a two-periodic complex structure (F, phi, psi) as in the cyclic complex equation, assumes the support of F has delta-dimension at most k+1 and the supports of both cohomology sheaves have delta-dimension at most k, and concludes [H^0(F, phi, psi)]_k ~ rat [H^1(F, phi, psi)]_k as k-cycles (statement lines 18416-18445). The proof builds the rational equivalence explicitly: it lists the irreducible components W_j of the support of F of dimension k+1, which form a locally finite family, attaches to each generic point xi_j the determinant f_j of the two-periodic complex at the stalk, which is a unit in the function field R(W_j), and claims the exact cycle identity -[H^0]_k + [H^1]_k = sum (W_j -> X)_* div(f_j) (proof lines 18448-18468). The identity is then verified coefficient by coefficient: for an integral closed subscheme Z of dimension k with generic point xi, the local ring A = O_{X,xi} and the module M = F_xi give dim(Supp M) = 1, the components W_j through xi correspond to the minimal primes q_i of Supp(M), and the two coefficients are computed as -e_A(M, phi, psi) on the left and as the sum of ord_{A/q_i}(det_{kappa(q_i)}(M_{q_i}, phi, psi)) on the right (proof lines 18471-18504). The identification of the two coefficient formulas with the length-determinant proposition is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
